title: PaneNode::open_into
description: Open a new instance beside a target pane, subject to the pane ceiling limit of 4 auto-split panes.
signature: pub fn open_into(&mut self, new_instance: String, pane_id: &str, dir: SplitDir) -> bool
semantics: Splits panes up to MAX_AUTO_PANES (4), then stacks remaining opens as tabs; returns false if pane not found.
